name: kamailio-lsp
description: Language support for kamailio.cfg configuration files (diagnostics via kamailio -c, completion, hover, go-to-definition).

kamailioLsp.serverPath.description: Path to the kamailio-lsp server binary. Leave at the default to use the server bundled with platform builds of this extension (falling back to a PATH lookup).

kamailioLsp.kamailioPath.description: Path to the kamailio binary used for -c diagnostics.

kamailioLsp.kamailioSrc.description: Kamailio source tree to harvest module documentation from (completion/hover).

kamailioLsp.kamailioWiki.description: kamailio-wiki checkout to harvest core-language documentation from (core parameters, functions, pseudo-variables).

kamailioLsp.modulesPath.description: Module search path passed to the checker as -L (empty = the binary's compiled-in default).

kamailioLsp.checkTimeoutMs.description: Upper bound (ms) on one 'kamailio -c' diagnostics run.

kamailioLsp.enable.description: Enable the Kamailio language server (restart applies automatically).

kamailioLsp.trace.server.description: Trace the LSP traffic between VS Code and kamailio-lsp in the output channel.

kamailioLsp.diagnostics.enable.description: Run 'kamailio -c' checks on open/save. Diagnostics are also disabled automatically in untrusted workspaces.

kamailioLsp.diagnostics.analyzer.description: Fast analyzer warnings between saves (undefined route() targets, duplicate route definitions), independent of 'kamailio -c'.

kamailioLsp.codeLens.references.description: Show reference-count code lenses above named route definitions (counted across the include closure).

kamailioLsp.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Draw parameter names from the documentation at module-function call sites.

kamailioLsp.inlayHints.defineValues.description: Draw what each #!define-family preprocessor symbol expands to, at its uses.

kamailioLsp.completion.snippets.description: Insert function completions as snippets with a tabstop between the parentheses.

kamailioLsp.cacheDir.description: Documentation-catalog cache directory (empty = the platform cache dir).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces, diagnostics are disabled: running 'kamailio -c' loads the modules the configuration references, which executes code. Completion, hover, and navigation stay available.
